note: Equivalence snapshot taken before the catalogue replaced the hand-kept maps (profiles.ts ESLINT_RULE_MAP, rule-copy.ts RULE_COPY, confidence.ts CONFIDENCE_BY_RULE). Update deliberately when a slice changes a mapping or the copy.

copy.title: Very large spec file
copy.why: Huge files are slow to review and shard, and hide shared state, so failures are harder to trace and fix.
copy.fix: Split the file by feature so each spec stays readable.

copy.title: Test whose checks we could not see
copy.why: The checks probably live in a helper the score cannot read, so a person should confirm the test really verifies the page.
copy.fix: Confirm the helper really asserts, or add an expect() to the test itself.

copy.title: File that could not be parsed
copy.why: The file cannot run, so none of its tests protect the product until the syntax error is fixed.
copy.fix: Fix the syntax error and re-run the score.

copy.title: Test with no assertion
copy.why: A test with no check passes even when the feature is broken, so a green build can hide a real outage.
copy.fix: Add at least one expect() that checks the outcome the test is named for.

copy.title: Deeply nested describe blocks
copy.why: Deep nesting makes test names and shared setup hard to follow.
copy.fix: Flatten describe blocks to at most two levels.

copy.title: Playwright call that is never awaited
copy.why: The test can finish before the step runs, so it passes while the feature is broken or fails at random.
copy.fix: Add await to every Playwright action and expect() call that returns a promise.

copy.title: Assertion that only sometimes runs
copy.why: The check can be skipped silently, so a broken feature can still go out under a green build.
copy.fix: Move the expect out of the condition so it always runs.

copy.title: Test logic that branches
copy.why: Different runs can check different things, so a green build does not reliably mean the feature works.
copy.fix: Split the branches into separate tests or use test.skip(condition, reason).

copy.title: Element handle instead of a locator
copy.why: Stale handles can fail after the page re-renders, which can show up as random red builds nobody can reproduce.
copy.fix: Replace $() and $$() handles with page.locator() or role-based locators.

copy.title: Page code evaluated inside the test
copy.why: It checks a snapshot that may be out of date, so a test can pass or fail for reasons unrelated to the product.
copy.fix: Use locator assertions such as toHaveText() or toHaveValue() in place of $eval.

copy.title: Focused test left in (test.only)
copy.why: test.only silently skips every other test in the run, so the build can look green while most of the suite never ran.
copy.fix: Remove .only and set forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI in the Playwright config.

copy.title: Click forced past a blocking element
copy.why: Forcing a click bypasses what a real user is blocked by, so a broken or covered button can ship with a green build.
copy.fix: Remove { force: true } and fix what is covering the element, or wait for it to be actionable.

copy.title: Waiting for the network to go quiet
copy.why: Pages that keep polling or streaming never go quiet, so tests that wait for it can time out at random and hold up releases without a real defect.
copy.fix: Wait for the specific element or response the test needs instead of networkidle.

copy.title: Debugger pause left in a test
copy.why: It halts the run until someone intervenes, so the CI job hangs and holds up the release pipeline.
copy.fix: Delete page.pause() calls before committing.

copy.title: CSS or XPath locator
copy.why: Selectors tied to CSS or XPath can break on a redesign, so a UI change can mean unplanned test maintenance.
copy.fix: Use getByRole, getByLabel or getByTestId so locators follow what the user sees.

copy.title: await on something that is not a promise
copy.why: It is harmless at runtime but signals that the author was unsure what is asynchronous.
copy.fix: Remove await from synchronous calls such as locator() and getByRole().

copy.title: Deprecated navigation wait
copy.why: This wait can miss the navigation it is waiting for, which causes random failures that block releases.
copy.fix: Assert on the new URL or page content with expect(page).toHaveURL() instead.

copy.title: Legacy selector wait
copy.why: Manual waits add delay and random failures that locators already handle, so CI is slower and less trusted.
copy.fix: Use a locator with an expect(...).toBeVisible() assertion in place of waitForSelector.

copy.title: Fixed pause before continuing
copy.why: Fixed delays make runs slower and can cause random red builds, so engineers re-run pipelines and learn to ignore failures.
copy.fix: Replace waitForTimeout() with a web-first assertion such as expect(locator).toBeVisible().

copy.title: Page method used where a locator is better
copy.why: Page-level helpers do not retry, so tests can fail on slow pages and need hand-fixing.
copy.fix: Create a locator and call the action on it.

copy.title: Generic locator where a built-in one exists
copy.why: Selectors tied to markup can break on redesigns, so UI changes can turn into test-maintenance work.
copy.fix: Switch locator("text=...") style calls to getByText, getByRole or getByLabel.

copy.title: Assertion that does not retry
copy.why: A one-shot check can fail when the page is a moment slow, so the build goes red without a real defect.
copy.fix: Use await expect(locator).toBeVisible() or toHaveText() in place of expect(await locator.isVisible()).

copy.title: Tests outside a describe block
copy.why: Grouping tests by feature keeps reports and failures easy to read.
copy.fix: Wrap related tests in a top-level test.describe() named for the feature.

copy.title: Malformed expect() call
copy.why: An incomplete check verifies nothing, so a broken feature can ship while the test reports success.
copy.fix: Complete each expect() with a matcher and await it.

copy.title: Lint rule switched off with a comment
copy.why: A disable comment hides a problem from reviewers and from this score, so known issues stay unfixed.
copy.fix: Fix the code the comment is hiding, or justify the exception in review.

copy.title: Selector tied to page layout
copy.why: A cosmetic redesign can break the test even though the product still works, which costs engineering time on false alarms.
copy.fix: Use a role, label or test id the page owner keeps stable.

copy.title: Very long timeout
copy.why: A long timeout hides slow or hung pages and makes a broken release take many minutes to be reported.
copy.fix: Remove the long timeout and fix the slow step, or wait for a specific condition.

copy.title: Test switched off with fixme
copy.why: The feature it covers has no automated check, so a regression there can ship unnoticed.
copy.fix: Fix and re-enable the test, or delete it and track the gap in the backlog.

copy.title: Tests that depend on each other through shared state
copy.why: One failure or a changed run order can make later tests fail for the wrong reason, so a failure report points at the wrong feature.
copy.fix: Create the data each test needs inside that test or in a fixture.

copy.title: Test that is switched off
copy.why: A skipped test protects nothing, and skipped tests tend to stay skipped, so coverage quietly shrinks.
copy.fix: Fix and re-enable each skipped test, or delete it.

copy.title: Assertion whose failure is ignored
copy.why: A failing check is caught and dropped, so the test passes while the feature may be broken. Deliberate soft checks are the usual exception.
copy.fix: Let the failure fail the test, or use expect.soft if the check is optional.

copy.title: Sleep written as a timer
copy.why: A timer is a fixed delay in disguise: it slows runs and can cause random red builds.
copy.fix: Replace the timer with an assertion on the state you are waiting for.

copy.title: Assertion that cannot fail
copy.why: It inflates the number of checks without checking the product, so coverage looks better than it is.
copy.fix: Assert on real page state, such as a heading, URL or row count.

copy.title: Click or navigation that is not awaited
copy.why: The test moves on before the action finishes, so it can fail at random or pass without the step having happened, and real regressions hide behind the noise.
copy.fix: Add await in front of the action.

copy.title: Missing await inside an assertion
copy.why: The assertion compares a pending promise instead of the page value, so it can pass or fail without checking the feature.
copy.fix: Add await, or use a web-first assertion such as toHaveText.

copy.title: Assertion that can never fail
copy.why: The check passes whatever the page shows, so the test gives false confidence that the feature works.
copy.fix: Assert on a concrete value, such as an exact count, text or URL.

copy.title: Tests that must run in order
copy.why: One failing step skips every test after it, so a single bug can hide the state of the rest of the flow.
copy.fix: Make each test independent, or keep serial mode only where the flow truly needs it.

copy.title: Assertion that passes on almost any page
copy.why: The document root is there and has text on nearly every page, including an error page, so the check passes when the feature is broken.
copy.fix: Assert on an element the test is about, such as a heading, a form or a row, instead of the document root.

copy.title: Visibility read that checks nothing
copy.why: The call returns at once and nothing looks at the answer, so the test passes whether the element is shown or not.
copy.fix: Use await expect(locator).toBeVisible() or toBeHidden(), which waits for the state and fails the test when it is wrong.
